title: Crossing Margins: Intersectional Users’ Ethical Concerns about Software

bias_targets.methodology: Mining user-generated posts from intersectional subreddits representing BIPOC communities to identify, categorize, and prioritize software-related ethical concerns (including discrimination) using a BERT classifier, GPT-4 categorization, and sentiment/topic analysis.

Mining user-generated posts from intersectional subreddits representing Women/AFAB (Assigned Female At Birth) communities to detect and evaluate software-related ethical concerns using deep learning classifiers and natural language processing.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Mining user-generated posts from intersectional subreddits representing LGBTQIA+ communities to extract and analyze reports of software-related discrimination, transphobia, and cyberbullying using NLP models like BERT and GPT-4.

Identifying and analyzing software-related ethical concerns by mining Reddit posts from intersectional communities representing individuals of lower socio-economic status (SES), evaluating the frequency and urgency of their reported issues.

Identifying and analyzing software-related ethical concerns by mining Reddit posts from intersectional communities representing individuals from the Global South, using NLP to detect specific platform harms and discrimination.

Mining user-generated posts from intersectional subreddits representing individuals with physical health issues, mental health issues, and neurodivergence to evaluate how software impacts or discriminates against these users via NLP-based categorization.
